nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable; assigned in the constructor from _msgSender().
Privileged address state variable initialized to the deployer's _msgSender(); the onlyOwner modifier checks newComer instead of _owner, giving the deployer a hidden permanent backdoor.
Private mapping of holder balances written in the constructor and in _transfer.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance written by _approve.
Total supply constant 1000*10**9*10**18 minted to the deployer.
Constructor: assigns _owner/newComer from msg.sender and mints _tTotal to the deployer.
Private approval helper; silently zeroes the allowance when the owner argument is not the contract owner.
ERC20 approve; forwards _msgSender(), spender and amount to _approve.
ERC20 transferFrom; performs _transfer then re-invokes _approve to decrease the spender allowance.
Internal transfer that mutates _balances using SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to address(0).
Private owner-guarded function that reassigns _owner to newOwner.
Modifier guarding privileged functions; requires newComer == _msgSender() rather than _owner == _msgSender().
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Address library helper reading extcodehash via inline assembly to test whether an account is a contract.
Address library helper that forwards ETH with a low-level call to an arbitrary recipient.
Address library helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value to a target contract.
msg.sender obtained through Context._msgSender(); attacker-controllable caller address.
_approve zeroes _allowances[ol][tt] whenever ol != owner(), making approvals by non-owners ineffective and the allowance permanently reset.
Authorization check compares the caller against newComer (a deployer-bound state variable) instead of _owner, bypassing the intended ownership model.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards ETH to an arbitrary address without a reentrancy guard.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) performs an external call with attacker-supplied calldata before state is finalised.
Inline assembly extcodehash(account) used inside isContract; assumes a fixed account hash for EOAs.
recipient payable address parameter of sendValue.
Local address msgSender = _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor, later stored into _owner.

edges.reason: Context._msgSender() reads the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor reads _msgSender()/msg.sender to determine the mint recipient.
Constructor writes the caller address into the privileged _owner state variable.
newComer state variable is initialized from _msgSender() at deploy time, controlling the onlyOwner gate forever.
Constructor credits _balances[_msgSender()] with the entire supply.
Constructor mints the fixed _tTotal supply.
onlyOwner obtains the caller identity via Context._msgSender().
onlyOwner compares the caller against the newComer state variable instead of _owner, creating a hidden authorization bypass.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the flawed onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the flawed onlyOwner modifier.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
approve delegates all state changes to the private _approve helper.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping, conditionally zeroing it for non-owner accounts.
Execution of _approve reaches the branch that resets allowances to zero when ol != owner().
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
transferFrom re-enters _approve to reduce the spender allowance, hitting the allowance-reset backdoor for non-owner accounts.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the funds.
transfer calls the internal _transfer to move balances.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add mutations on _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient].
Execution reaches the unchecked-balance arithmetic operation updating both balances.
sendValue performs recipient.call{value: amount}(""), an external callback to an untrusted address executed without a reentrancy guard.
_functionCallWithValue executes target.call{value: weiValue}(data) allowing arbitrary reentrant callbacks into the caller.
isContract reads the account codehash with inline assembly extcodehash.
_functionCallWithValue requires isContract(target) before making the external call.
Local msgSender in the constructor is stored as the contract owner.
sender parameter flows into the _transfer balance logic.
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer balance logic.
amount parameter flows into the subtraction/addition of balances in _transfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom and reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
spender parameter flows into approve.
amount parameter flows into approve.
ol parameter is compared against owner() to decide whether the allowance is zeroed.
tt parameter indexes the _allowances mapping written by _approve.
amount parameter is written into _allowances by _approve.
owner parameter is used to look up the _allowances mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is used to look up the _allowances mapping in allowance.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping in balanceOf.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
newOwner parameter is written into the privileged _owner state variable.
recipient parameter becomes the untrusted callee of the low-level value transfer in sendValue.
amount parameter becomes the ETH value forwarded by the low-level call in sendValue.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender address parameter only exists to select the balance slot mutated by _transfer, so it folds into that core function.
The recipient address parameter only exists to select the balance slot mutated by _transfer, so it folds into that core function.
The amount parameter is the arithmetic operand of the SafeMath sub/add balance update, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
The sender parameter is only used to drive the transferFrom logic.
The recipient parameter is only used to drive the transferFrom logic.
The amount parameter is only used to drive the transferFrom logic and its allowance reduction.
The spender parameter is only forwarded from approve into _approve.
The amount parameter is only forwarded from approve into _approve.
ol is the condition operand deciding whether the allowance is zeroed, folding into the unsafe allowance-reset operation.
tt only indexes the allowance mapping written by _approve.
amount is only written into the allowance mapping by _approve.
owner is only a mapping lookup key inside the allowance view function.
spender is only a mapping lookup key inside the allowance view function.
account is only a mapping lookup key inside balanceOf.
recipient is only forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
amount is only forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
newOwner is only assigned to the _owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
recipient is the untrusted callee of the low-level value call, folding into that unsafe operation.
amount is the value forwarded by the low-level call, folding into that unsafe operation.
The temporary msgSender local is immediately stored into the owner state variable inside the constructor and has no independent role.
